messages:
emma_sales: Uploaded the HORIZON pen-test package to secure share. Customer asked for artifacts + timeline. Link: https://secure.redwood.example/horizon/1999999999 :paperclip:
audit_bot: Artifacts saved to s3://redwood-secure/horizon/1999999999/
  - report: horizon-pt.pdf
  - scanner-xml: horizon-scan.xml.gz
  - pocs: horizon-pocs.tar.gz
  - manifest: horizon-manifest.json
  - checksums: horizon-1999999999.sha256
raj_se: Legal flagged tokens/usernames in a few PoCs. We should redact PII and internal hostnames before sharing. Also include CVSS and exploitability notes in the manifest.
jo_eng: I can run the scrub job tonight. I'll swap binaries for stepwise pseudo-PoCs and strip headers from logs. ETA to produce sanitized bundle: 199999/+1 (tomorrow EOD) -> 2000002000.
chris_ciso: Conditions to release: (1) sanitized bundle only unless NDA addendum signed; (2) remediation SLA documented; (3) assign security contact. Propose SLA: Critical=7d, High=21d, Medium=45d.
emma_sales: HORIZON asked for 30 days. We'll push proposed SLA and ask if they want accelerated patching for criticals. Also clarify whether they need raw exploit code under NDA.
raj_se: Added a one-page Risk Acceptance template. I'll attach after scrub completes. If customer insists on raw PoCs, require controlled access via our jumpbox and an NDA addendum.
jo_eng: scrub run complete. Replaced hostnames with <REDACTED_HOST>, removed creds, converted binaries to pseudo-PoC markdown. Uploaded sanitized bundle to s3://redwood-secure/horizon/1999999999/sanitized/ and updated manifest.
audit_bot: Sanitary bundle published by jo_eng at 2000001200. Link expiry: 30 days. SHA256: b1c2d3... horizon-sanitized-1999999999.sha256
chris_ciso: Reviewed sanitized bundle. OK to share. Conditions reiterated: NDA addendum required for raw artifacts, remediation timeline in writing, security contact=security@redwood.com.
emma_sales: Drafting email to HORIZON sec: attach sanitized bundle + manifest + CVSS table + proposed SLA. Ask if they require raw PoCs and offer NDA addendum + controlled access.
raj_se: Include runbook for mitigations and quick workaround flags (we have a rate-limit toggle and an auth patch work-around). Also attach the RA template.
jo_eng: Opened ticket HZ-9001 for fixes (auth and rate-limit). ETA critical patch 5 business days. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HZ-9001
emma_sales: Sending now. Will cc chris_ciso and raj_se. If they request raw PoC access, route to legal for NDA addendum. :thumbsup:
audit_bot: Notification: sanitized bundle shared with security contact at horizon-corp.com (pending acceptance).
